agents.name: Researcher
agents.description: The Researcher agent works within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to synthesize information, brainstorm ideas, and create quality in-depth content quickly and easily, enabling you and your team to tackle complex research tasks efficiently.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.description: The Analyst agent works within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to transform complex data into clear insights and visualizations, enabling you and your team to make informed decisions quickly and efficiently.

agents.name: Facilitator
agents.description: The Facilitator agent works alongside you and your team to help you manage Teams meetings effortlessly by taking notes, getting quick answers, and moderating the conversation.

agents.name: Interpreter
agents.description: The Interpreter agent enables real-time speech-to-speech interpretation in Teams meetings so each participant can speak and listen in the language of their choice in up to nine languages.

agents.name: Sales Agent
agents.description: Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot enables sellers with a smarter way to prepare, uncover insights, and walk into customer meetings ready to win. It brings insights from CRM systems, emails, meetings, enterprise content stores and other sales applications into the flow of work. Integrates with both Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce CRM.

agents.name: Finance Agent
agents.description: Finance agents accelerate time-to-impact for finance professionals by surfacing insights that support strategic decision-making and reduce the time that's spent on manual, repetitive work.

agents.name: Word Agent
agents.description: Word Agent creates and refines long‑form documents from a prompt — handling structure, research, and formatting so you can focus on ideas.
notes: Requires Anthropic to be enabled for the tenant.

agents.name: Excel Agent
agents.description: Excel Agent builds and analyzes spreadsheets using natural language — generating formulas, charts, summaries, and performing multi‑step data tasks with iterative reasoning.
notes: Requires Anthropic to be enabled for the tenant.

agents.name: PowerPoint Agent
agents.description: PowerPoint Agent turns prompts into complete presentations — generating slides, layouts, visuals, and helping refine content.
notes: Requires Anthropic to be enabled for the tenant.

agents.name: Planner Agent
agents.description: The Planner Agent brings Planner's intelligent task and plan management capabilities directly into Copilot Chat. Create, update, and manage your tasks, ask questions about your tasks, and create structured plans without switching apps.

agents.name: Surveys Agent
agents.description: Surveys Agent helps you create, send, and analyze surveys—turning feedback into actionable insights with minimal effort.

agents.name: Learning Agent
agents.description: Offers personalized Copilot usage tips based on current workstreams, curated learning paths, and AI-powered role-play exercises.

agents.name: Microsoft 365 Admin Agent
agents.description: Copilot for admins helps simplify administration of Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. It helps admins focus on more strategic priorities and helps you perform administrative tasks across different Microsoft 365 services.
notes: Licensing: Available for all users with an admin role for tenants with at least one paid Copilot license or PayGo.

agents.name: Writing Coach
agents.description: Writing Coach helps users improve clarity, tone, and effectiveness of their writing by offering real-time suggestions, rewrites, and feedback.

agents.name: Career Coach
agents.description: Career Coach provides personalized suggestions and action plans to help users advance in their careers.

agents.name: Plan My Day
agents.description: Plan My Day turns a user's calendar, emails, Teams messages, and files into a prioritized morning briefing - surfacing what to focus on first, what can wait, and what needs a decision now.

agents.name: SME Finder
agents.description: SME Finder surfaces the most credible subject-matter experts across the organization for any topic, product, process, or customer - returning ranked experts with cited evidence and a ready-to-send outreach message.

agents.name: Prompt Coach
agents.license: No additional license — included for Copilot Chat users
agents.description: Prompt Coach helps users craft clearer, more effective prompts by suggesting improvements and refinements to get better results from Copilot.
notes: Licensing: Available for all Copilot Chat users as a 1P agent. No cost incurred.

agents.name: Ideas Coach
agents.license: No additional license — included for Copilot Chat users
agents.description: Ideas Coach helps users brainstorm, expand, and refine ideas by generating suggestions, outlines, and creative directions within Microsoft apps.
notes: Licensing: Available for all Copilot Chat users as a 1P agent. No cost incurred.

agents.name: AI Learning Advisor
agents.license: No additional license — included for Copilot Chat users
agents.description: AI Learning Advisor helps users build skills across Microsoft's AI and low-code stack - Agent Builder, Copilot Studio, and Pro Code - with personalized learning plans, tool recommendations, and step-by-step troubleshooting, grounded in Microsoft Learn and Copilot Developer Camp.
notes: Licensing: Available for all Copilot Chat users as a 1P agent. No cost incurred.

agents.name: Workflows Agent
agents.description: Workflows can help you automate tasks like sending emails and reminders, managing calendars, and sharing team updates.

agents.name: Workforce Insights Agent
agents.description: The Workforce Insights Agent gives leaders and their delegates real-time, comprehensive views of their organization for faster, more informed workforce decisions.

agents.name: Legal Agent
agents.description: The Legal Agent works within Copilot in Word to help legal professionals review and negotiate contracts. It flags risky or non-standard clauses, compares them to internal playbook guidelines, and generates negotiation-ready redlines (tracked changes).
notes: Currently available only for users on US-based tenants who are physically present in the US.

agents.name: Employee Self-Service (ESS)
agents.description: ESS is a centralized agent for employee HR/IT self-service that helps employees complete HR and IT tasks (checking leave, updating info, device requests) all in one place, with prebuilt connectors.

agents.name: Frontline Agent
agents.description: An AI‑powered assistant designed to support frontline workers in their day‑to‑day operations and delivers concise, persona-tuned responses to help complete tasks and access the right information at the right time.

agents.name: Agents in Channels
agents.description: Channel agents are experts grounded in conversations and meetings, helping your team stay on top of tasks, summarize info, and streamline productivity.

agents.name: Agents in Communities
agents.description: Accelerate community knowledge sharing and make expertise readily available across organizations with Viva Engage.
surfaces: Agent Menu Tools drop-down in Chat

agents.name: Knowledge Management Agent
agents.description: Keep knowledge articles perpetually current by uncovering insights from case notes and other artifacts.

agents.name: Customer Intent Agent
agents.description: Enable evergreen self-service by discovering customer intent from customer conversations across channels.

agents.name: Quality Evaluation Agent
agents.description: Monitor service quality across customer interactions—from service reps to self-service agents.

agents.name: Case Management Agent
agents.description: Automate the case lifecycle to reduce handle time and alleviate the burden of manual tasks on service reps.

agents.name: Sales Qualification Agent
agents.description: Researches, prioritizes, and engages inbound leads, then hands off only high‑intent, qualified leads to sellers.

agents.name: Sales Research Agent
agents.description: Get answers to strategic, multi-faceted questions that sales leaders have about their business and operational performance.

agents.name: Sales Opportunity Agent
agents.description: Researches opportunities, identifies emerging risks, and highlights the highest-priority deals so sellers can close faster.

agents.name: Sales Development Agent
agents.description: The Sales Development agent continuously researches sales leads, crafts personalized outreach emails, and automatically follows up to ensure no lead is left behind. It scales your sales team’s capacity and acts like a teammate. Integrates with D365 Sales, Salesforce CRM, and CSV files.

agents.name: Sales Close Agent
agents.description: Autonomously analyze deals to equip your sellers with insights they need to win.

agents.name: Supplier Communications (Supply Chain)
agents.license: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain / Finance & Ops / Project Operations
agents.description: Copilot in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management reads and categorizes incoming supplier emails (confirmations, change requests, etc.), links them to the correct purchase orders, sends follow-up emails, and flags supply risks.

agents.name: Account Reconciliations (Finance)
agents.license: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain / Finance & Ops / Project Operations
agents.description: Copilot in Dynamics 365 Finance assists finance teams during period-end close by identifying ledger discrepancies and suggesting remediation actions to reconcile accounts.

agents.name: Time Entry Agent
agents.license: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain / Finance & Ops / Project Operations
agents.description: The Time Entry Agent automates the time entry by generating weekly time entries based on project assignments and bookings and sends reminders for any missing entries.

agents.name: Expense Agent
agents.license: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain / Finance & Ops / Project Operations
agents.description: The Expense Agent reduces manual effort and errors in expense management by automating workflows for receipt processing, expense line creation, and expense report generation.

agents.name: Activity Approvals Agent
agents.license: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain / Finance & Ops / Project Operations
agents.description: The Approvals Agent streamlines the approval process for time, expense, and material transactions.

agents.name: Scheduling Operations Agent
agents.license: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain / Finance & Ops / Project Operations
agents.description: Allows dispatchers to improve the schedule of a single technician quickly and efficiently. Dispatchers often spend considerable time on the schedule board adjusting technician schedules manually throughout their day.
